method: each scenario is defined once in trading_bot.research.economic_recovery.causality, run here against real holdout tapes, and asserted caught by tests/unit/research/test_edge16_causality.py

BTCUSDT.expectation: audit_trade reports the same-bar close-to-open exploit
BTCUSDT.injected: an exit read off bar 500's close and filled at bar 500's open (vol_regime_breakout)
BTCUSDT.observed: exit precedes entry; exit: earliest fill 1786561200000 precedes availability 1786564800000; exit filled at or before its own signal bar: the same-bar close-to-open exploit

BTCUSDT.expectation: a real proposal carries nothing from the future, and the detector notices when one does
BTCUSDT.injected: an exit price attached to a real entry proposal
BTCUSDT.observed: real proposal fields ['close', 'rank', 'rule']; injected payload flags ['exit_price']

BTCUSDT.expectation: the open position is marked at the last close, flagged is_mark, and audits clean
BTCUSDT.injected: the tape cut at bar 1854 of 2000, while a position was still open

BTCUSDT.expectation: the next present bar is used, nothing is invented, and no fill lands in the hole
BTCUSDT.injected: 4 consecutive hours removed from the tape
BTCUSDT.observed: 29 trades on the holed tape, 0 problem(s)

BTCUSDT.expectation: the decision waits for the late data, and the too-early fill is refused
BTCUSDT.injected: a bar whose data is only available 15 minutes after its close
BTCUSDT.observed: fill at the next bar after the late data clears (True); fill at the immediate next open: ['exit precedes entry']

BTCUSDT.expectation: the machine refuses a bar older than one it has already seen
BTCUSDT.injected: bar 300 re-delivered after 600 bars had already been decided on

BTCUSDT.expectation: the re-entry is dropped, so one lane never holds two positions at once
BTCUSDT.injected: a rule that would re-enter on the very bar its previous exit filled
